decisive_items: plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, fragments of collagenous matrix
firm to hard without changes in the overlying skin
Ultrasonography confirmed that all lesions were confined to the subcutaneous tissue
response.rationale: R2 best matches the bland spindle-cell cytology with collagenous matrix and firm consistency; R4 is a reasonable alternative because of multiple subcutaneous mobile lesions but lacks specific neurofibroma features such as wavy nuclei or NF1 stigmata. R1 is less likely due to the purely subcutaneous non-dermal distribution, R3 is contradicted by firm-hard lesions, and R5 is typically a solitary dermal process with overlying skin changes.

rejected.why: DFSP is usually dermal/solitary; the purely subcutaneous multiple lesions and bland cytology without necrosis are not characteristic.
Lipomatosis is contradicted by firm-to-hard lesions and spindle-cell collagenous cytology.
Dermatofibroma is usually a solitary dermal lesion with overlying skin changes, not multiple subcutaneous swellings.
